status: opened partial A architecture diagnostic; no runtime promotion

candidate.representation: full canonical YV BM25 plus eight Gemma-generated Swedish description phrases appended to each of 149 concept documents; generated phrases are not exact identity surfaces

size.projection_warning: The 255,750-byte figure is a linear projection from the partial 149-concept corpus, not a measured full-corpus artifact.

strict_source_attested_17.interpretation: Not a useful coverage test of A yet because only 2/17 target concepts were teacher-expanded.

full_replacement_canonical_source_truth_.interpretation: Do not replace the ordinary YV lexical lane with the expanded ranker. Track 1 remains the unchanged privileged selector path; A is a separate description fallback entrypoint. The 333-case suite contains both canonical-label and canonical-definition queries, so query-text heuristics are not the correct lane boundary.

decision.result: positive partial proof for sequence-level teacher expansion
decision.reason: With only 149/2105 concepts expanded and 20/40 stress target families covered, A149 improves opened targetable stress Hit@5 from 18/40 to 24/40 while adding only 18,103 gzip bytes of compact teacher language. This is materially stronger than Round-0 B0/C0/D0 formulations and supports generating the full A corpus.
decision.next_step: Generate/freeze Gemma expansion for the full 2,105-occupation universe without using opened evaluation queries, measure the actual compressed artifact, then replay the same frozen diagnostics. Keep ordinary lexical YV/KV calls separate and unchanged.
decision.abstention_note: A149 did not improve ambiguous/nonsense/out-of-scope abstention. Abstention remains a separate unresolved residual and must not be tuned on the opened 88-case suite.

evidence_warning: The 17-case and 88-input stress suites are already-opened development/architecture evidence. This result can justify continuing or falsifying an architecture class, but cannot establish independent user accuracy or choose production thresholds.
